facts.fact: The IPDCP's communique cites Law No. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 on personal data protection, whose articles 84 and 92 set one to five years' prison and fines up to CFAF 20 million.
The IPDCP, led by a named president, is acting as the supervisory body under Law No. 2019-014 in its communique of 5 November 2026.
The IPDCP warned against social-media calls to identify and expose people, reminding that such collection and disclosure breach the law; no sanction or decision is stated.
